exposure: Participation in health education during pregnancy
Husband support for breastfeeding (measured by PSSS score)
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding rate within 6 months postpartum
cohort: The study included 420 twin mothers who delivered in the study hospital from January 2019 to December 2022.
finding: The rate of exclusive breastfeeding in twin mothers was 21.90%, with factors such as maternal age, education level, nipple issues, breast tenderness, postpartum depression, breast milk volume, health education during pregnancy, husband support, infant diarrhea, lactose intolerance, and delectation significantly influencing exclusive breastfeeding.
